exact_scope: Literal interpretation: C1 requires the released survival-distribution architecture and paper-scale optimization rather than a reduced model; C4 requires four-seed matched HSVL and HIQL on HumanoidMaze-giant; C5 requires both visual-AntMaze-giant and AntMaze-giant under the same matched protocol; C6 requires four-seed flat SVL and re-evaluated CRL on HumanoidMaze-giant with the same DDPG+BC actor. Each performance seed is evaluated on five task IDs with 50 episodes per task. No proxy task, reduced update count, missing comparator, paper-number-only comparison, or source inspection is scientific evidence.

pattern_checks.pattern: survival distribution rather than a TD value

decision_basis: This is the strongest reading of the paper and exactly matches the judge gates: architecture-, task-, method-, comparator-, seed-, and episode-level parity.
The released HSVL configuration specifies one million updates, 512-wide three-layer networks, 256 bases across 16 sets, a survival horizon of 10000, and five-by-50 evaluation episodes.
C4, both conjuncts of C5, and C6 require multiple one-million-update actor trainings; the first-round audits found no CPU-scale substitute that retains this scope.
C1 cannot be upgraded by a width, bin, or update bump below the released architecture. The exact released training route shares the same accelerator-bound computation.
GPU and T4 execution are forbidden by the campaign policy, so the faithful literal route is blocked rather than silently reduced.
blockers: C1 exact released architecture at paper update scale requires accelerator training; the bounded CPU route would not finish at claim scale.
C4 needs eight paper-scale HumanoidMaze-giant trainings (four HSVL and four HIQL) plus matched evaluation.
C5 needs both visual and state AntMaze-giant comparisons, totaling sixteen paper-scale trainings.
C6 needs eight paper-scale HumanoidMaze-giant trainings with the same DDPG+BC actor.
All authorized backends in this campaign are CPU-only; substituting a small CPU experiment would remain toy or inconclusive.
next_step: Stop this interpretation as BLOCKED. Do not launch HF CPU-upgrade or any GPU job, and do not treat the route audit as scientific evidence.
